groups.label: Beat Generation
groups.description: American poets and novelists who lived and wrote in Paris in the late 1950s and early 1960s.

groups.label: Jazz & Existentialism
groups.description: Jazz in Paris, from the 1920s clubs of rue Pigalle to the post-Liberation cellars and cafés of Saint-Germain-des-Prés and the Latin Quarter.

groups.label: Lettrists & Situationists
groups.description: The Lettrist International (1952–1957) and the Situationist International (1957–1972).

groups.label: Surrealism
groups.description: André Breton's circle and the Surrealist movement, from the 1920s onward.

groups.label: Montmartre Bohème
groups.description: Cabarets, dance halls, cheap studios and artists' cafés of Montmartre and Pigalle, from the 1880s to the 1920s.

groups.label: Chanson & Popular Paris
groups.description: Working-class eastern Paris: chanson, cooperatives and the streets of Belleville and Ménilmontant.

groups.label: Lost Generation & Expatriates
groups.description: English-language writers in interwar Paris: the Lost Generation and fellow expatriates.

groups.label: Subterranean Paris
groups.description: Paris underground in the literal sense: the quarries and ossuary beneath Denfert-Rochereau and the 1944 Resistance command post.

groups.label: May 1968
groups.description: The student revolt and occupations of May–June 1968 in the Latin Quarter.

groups.label: Nineteenth-century literary Paris
groups.description: Reserved for future entries: Baudelaire, Rimbaud, Verlaine and the Symbolists and Decadents. Hidden until a location uses it.
